title: Yung Dub D shares a healing new single, "Heal"
htmlContent:
Music artist Yung Dub D has healed us with his new single, "Heal," which is his most infectious, catchy, and down-to-earth song. 

Yung Dub D talks about his latest single, "Helping everyone attain love is something I put together to help others in a healing process because it is relatable, and others need to know the importance of healing through relationships."  

What Yung Dub D brings to the game is something few other artists can deliver. With a smooth sound and catchy hooks, this emerging act continues to build artistry around digging into his personal experiences and feelings in a way that pulls us in and comforts us. As a result, Yung Dub D is now one of those artists regarded as the future.

Stream Yung Dub D's "Heal" on Spotify.
